description: Wraps TDDepthAnything v2 (community TOX by IntentDev) to convert any 2D image/video TOP into a depth map TOP using Depth Anything v2 via NVIDIA TensorRT/ONNX — no Kinect or RealSense required. Given a source TOP path, drops the TOX into a fresh container, wires the source, exposes a depth Null TOP whose path can be fed directly into create_depth_displacement, create_depth_pop_field, or create_depth_silhouette. Requires the user to have installed TDDepthAnything.tox from https://github.com/IntentDev/TDDepthAnything and an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA + TensorRT pre-built weights (.engine/.onnx). NOT supported on macOS. First cook may take 30–60 s for engine compile. Returns container_path, dropped_tox_path, depth_top_path (the key output), source_top_path, output_resolution, model_variant, and warnings.

model_variant.description: Depth Anything v2 model size. small = ~25 ms/frame on RTX 3070, large = ~80 ms but cleaner edges. The TOX must have the matching .engine/.onnx weight on disk.

output_resolution.description: Square inference resolution. Lower = faster, higher = sharper depth edges. Default 512 matches Depth Anything v2 sweet spot on a 30-series GPU.

parent_path.description: Parent network for the depth_from_2d baseCOMP.

source_top_path.description: Absolute TD path of the 2D source TOP (movieFileInTOP / videoDeviceInTOP / NDI-in / any cooked TOP). Required.

tox_path.description: Override path to TDDepthAnything.tox. When omitted, candidates are tried in order. Set this when the TOX lives outside ~/Documents/Derivative.

name: create_depth_from_2d
title: Create depth from 2D
